home.select: HOME: all -- choose axes or press HOME
lock.missing: lock {object} {field} not found in the firmware
switch.off: jogpad is switched off in Mainsail or Fluidd
switch.ready: Switch set up in {path}. Restart Klipper and Moonraker to see it in Mainsail and Fluidd.
switch.unchanged: Switch already set up in {path}; macro refreshed.
pad.cannot_program: Layout {layout} cannot be programmed into a pad: {error}
pad.not_found: No CH57x pad with USB ID 1189:8840 or 1189:8842 found. Is it plugged in? jogpad programs pads on Linux only.
pad.no_access: No permission to write {device}. Run the installer again, it lets the group input program the pad, then log in again.
pad.done: Done. Check the keys with jogpad keys or on the web page.
keys.prompt: Press keys, Ctrl+C to quit. Nothing moves.
input.linux_only: Reading input devices is only supported on Linux so far.
ui.switch_off_note: jogpad is off: no key does anything, STOP included.
ui.recent_empty: Press a key on the pad.
ui.panel_missing: Show the pad and its state there as the camera “jogpad”.
ui.panel_done: Added. Pick the camera “jogpad” in Mainsail or Fluidd.
ui.panel_local: Open this page with the printer's address, not 127.0.0.1 or localhost: Mainsail and Fluidd load the view from that address.
ui.setup_note: Changes are saved to jogpad.toml and apply at once.
ui.press_key: Press the key for {action} now. Nothing moves meanwhile; STOP still works.
ui.taken: {key} already triggers {action}. Use it for {target} instead?
ui.press_axis: Press the key for {action} on the pad and watch what moves. The machine moves.
ui.what_moved: What moved, seen from the front of the machine?
ui.dir.nothing_hint: Then the machine refused the move, see the console. Is it homed?
ui.direction_fixed: {axis} reversed. Check again to be sure.
ui.forbidden: Changes are only allowed from computers Moonraker trusts (trusted_clients), or with allow_remote_changes.
